description: This source file appears to be part of Git's internal implementation, managing worktrees including their creation, validation, repair, and linkage. It contains functions for handling worktree metadata, configuration, referencing, and filesystem interactions.

methods.name: void free_worktree(struct worktree * worktree)
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a worktree structure, including its associated strings and the structure itself.

methods.name: void free_worktrees(struct worktree ** worktrees)
methods.description: Frees an array of worktree pointers and their associated memory.

methods.name: struct:worktree * get_main_worktree(int skip_reading_head)

methods.name: struct:worktree ** get_worktrees_without_reading_head(void)
methods.description: Returns an array of all worktrees without reading their head information.

methods.name: int is_main_worktree(const struct worktree * wt)
methods.description: Determines if a given worktree is the main worktree (no ID).

methods.name: const char * worktree_lock_reason(struct worktree * wt)

methods.name: int is_worktree_being_bisected(const struct worktree * wt,const char * target)

methods.name: int submodule_uses_worktrees(const char * path)
